  • Thu, Apr 30 — 13:00–14:30

Can you confirm which of those works for you and Daniel? If none fit, send 2–3 alternatives and we’ll align. I’ve attached the short discovery notes we took during the call.

1) Architecture & security: VPC options, KMS/HSM integration, audit log retention
2) Serving/runtime: model sizing, expected sequence lengths, batching and latency SLOs
3) Proof-of-concept plan & success criteria
4) Integration checklist and next steps

I’ll loop in our ML/Infra and CS leads once you pick a time so they have visibility.
